args.name: component
args.description: Consuming ASCET component path containing the local dependent parameter.

args.name: dependent-element
args.description: Local dependent parameter name to analyze.

args.name: --exporter
args.description: Optional exporter/provider component path used as a verification constraint.

args.name: --provider-scope
args.description: Optional folder or scope path used to bound provider discovery.

args.name: --max-candidates
args.description: Maximum provider candidates to inspect during discovery.

preconditions: ASCET ToolAPI session must be available.
The consuming component path must resolve to a code component.
The dependent element must exist in the consuming component export XML for a complete chain.

examples.description: Verify against a known exporter component

pitfalls: Do not require users to know the exporter component path before calling this command.
